how: We read the website of every Charlotte wedding videographer listed on Lazo (118 listings, 83 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: business marketing video houses, corporate AV crews, a day-of coordination company listed as video, and a national booking network with a Charlotte page. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Are the vows and toasts recorded on lapel mics and a board feed, or just the camera, and can I hear a sample from an outdoor ceremony?
Is raw footage included, and how long until the highlight film and the full-length edit arrive?
Outdoor ceremonies here run hot and bright in summer; how do you handle harsh midday light and a sudden rain move indoors?

picks.name: Marsan Productions
picks.blurb: Marsan Productions films weddings, destinations, engagements and elopements out of Charlotte for couples it describes as adventurous and lively, and prints its prices on the site, in the $2,500 to $2,800 range at our read. Almost five years of filming and shooting weddings, with photos offered alongside video.

picks.name: Firefly Films
picks.blurb: Firefly Films is a wedding cinematography company in Waxhaw that limits its bookings to stay focused on each couple's details. Packages are printed on the site, with the single-cinematographer Ladybug package listed at $2,400, and the team travels across the Southeast or beyond.

picks.name: Carlisle Films
picks.blurb: A Rock Hill team filming since 2010, with more than 250 weddings for 250 couples, led by cofounder and lead filmmaker Drew Carlisle with Ashley Carlisle running the office. Carlisle Films makes a point of blending into the background to catch unforced emotion, and lists WeddingWire Couples' Choice awards year after year.

picks.name: M&P Weddings & Films
picks.blurb: M&P Weddings & Films in Waxhaw pitches luxury wedding video built on candid storytelling and clean audio, with raw footage included and a 100 percent happiness guarantee. The site shows films from the Biltmore Estate in Asheville and notes that AC/DC's bass player chose them for his son's wedding.

picks.name: Robert Burns II Photography & Videography, LLC
picks.blurb: Robert Burns II Photography & Videography covers the day in both photo and video from Huntersville, with 15 years in the industry and more than 200 weddings. Engagement videography teasers are offered too, and the site promises preview photos within 24 hours.

picks.name: Candle and Quill Photography
picks.blurb: A Charlotte husband-and-wife duo telling wedding stories through both photo and film. Candle and Quill's collections cover elopements and full-day weddings with videography options in each tier, so one team can handle both.

picks.name: Off The Rails Studios
picks.blurb: Off The Rails Studios makes candid wedding films and photography for couples in Charlotte, Fort Mill and across the Carolinas. Tristan and Sophie stumbled into video and kept going, and the site leads with words from their couples.

picks.name: Indigo Photography
picks.blurb: Indigo Photography and Video is owned by photographers Andy Chen and Stephanie Welch with videographer Shamus Coneys, documenting weddings from Charlotte across the East Coast and beyond. Modern, fresh and edgy is their own description, working discreetly to catch the emotion of the day.

picks.name: Discover Love Studios
picks.blurb: Brittany and Clint of Discover Love Studios are a husband-and-wife photo and video team in Charlotte serving NC and SC and willing to travel. They get to know you before touching a camera, on the idea that real photos come from vulnerable moments with people you trust.

picks.name: Bhowmik Dave Films & Photography - Wedding Photographers & Videographers
picks.blurb: Bhowmik Dave Films & Photography is a Charlotte-based wedding photography and cinematography company that specializes in South Asian weddings and customizes its services to each client. Serves the Carolinas, travels across the US and takes destination weddings.
